title: ProofPack input table schema v1
description: One row of the canonical (post-mapping) test table. Column names are canonical roles as seen by the engine after `proofpack map`; original headers live in mapping.json and never leave the machine. Prose source: D1 section 1.

row_id.description: Unique per row; join key for version N vs N-1 (paired compare). Duplicates -> H05.

case_id.description: Cluster unit (patient/study). n_rows > n_cases triggers the clustered path.

y_true.description: Values must be a subset of declared classes.positive ∪ classes.negative ∪ indeterminates.values, else H02.

score.description: Continuous output. Orientation and type are declared, never inferred. If score.type == probability, values outside [0,1] -> H03.

y_pred.description: Optional. Non-blank values must be a subset of declared classes.positive ∪ classes.negative ∪ indeterminates.values, else H02 (repair 1 of build day 8); must equal rule(score, threshold) at every declared operating point on every row, else H04. A blank cell on a table without a score column is a missing prediction input: the row is excluded and counted under flow.excluded_missing_score (repair 2 of build day 8); a value in indeterminates.values marks the row indeterminate (flow.indeterminate).

indeterminate.description: 0/1 alternative to listing indeterminate values in y_true / y_pred.

age.description: Banded by declared age_bands; no default bands exist.

event_date.description: ISO date. Coarsened at ingest to declared period.granularity; raw dates never appear in output. Present without a period declaration -> H11.

^attr_[a-z0-9_]{1,26}$.description: Customer extra attribute; numeric extras need declared bands.

^rater_[a-z0-9_]{1,25}$.description: Echoed in Table 1 only; never used to construct y_true.
